title_fil: Ang BHW bilang Tagapagsulong ng Primary Care
title_en: The BHW as a Primary Care Advocate
source_hour_note: Owner planning decision 2026-09-29 uses F101 monitoring detail (72 hours); F45 overview prints 64 and a 384-hour total.

modules.title_fil: Mga serbisyo sa primary care at pag-uugnay sa serbisyo

lessons.objective_en: Given a resident request and an approved local directory, identify the appropriate BHS/PCF/RHU service category and limits of the BHW role.
lessons.practice_en: Sort fictional requests by service and responsible provider.
lessons.indicator_en: Names a supported destination and avoids promising an unverified service.

lessons.objective_en: Given three life-stage cases, identify a relevant service need and the information to confirm locally.
lessons.indicator_en: States the need, a plausible service entry point, and a fact requiring confirmation.
lessons.title_fil: Serbisyo ayon sa yugto ng buhay

lessons.objective_en: Given an uncertain service request, use the verified local directory to connect the resident to a qualified provider and hand over essential facts with consent.
lessons.indicator_en: Checks urgency, obtains permission, states who/where/when, communicates facts accurately, and records a follow-up.

modules.title_fil: BHW bilang tagapagsulong ng kalusugan sa barangay

lessons.objective_en: Given a community case, identify a non-medical barrier and one health promotion action within the BHW role.
lessons.practice_en: “Kwento ni Rosario” or a newly permission-cleared case with Five Whys.
lessons.indicator_en: Distinguishes the barrier from a diagnosis and proposes an achievable action with partners.
lessons.title_fil: Papel ng HEPO at mga hadlang sa kalusugan

lessons.objective_en: Given a resident's concern, ask, listen, check understanding, and agree a next step.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses an open question, reflects the concern, respects context and privacy, and invites correction.

lessons.objective_en: Given two audience segments and one approved health claim, choose a message/channel/material suited to each.
lessons.practice_en: Audience–channel card sort and message rehearsal.
lessons.indicator_en: States the audience, barrier, reviewed message, and why the channel fits.
lessons.title_fil: Mensahe at paraan ayon sa kausap

lessons.objective_en: Given a local hazard briefing, relay a verified action without speculation and identify the official update channel.
lessons.indicator_en: Separates confirmed facts from unknowns, gives a feasible action, and names where to check updates.

lessons.objective_en: Given community feedback, log the concern without identifiable gossip and return it to the appropriate team.
lessons.indicator_en: Records a theme and source context, escalates accurately, and explains how the community will hear the response.

modules.title_fil: Kumilos nang higit, kumain nang wasto
modules.title_en: Priority area 1: Move More, Eat Right

lessons.objective_en: Given a household's routine, select one feasible reviewed food or activity message without shaming.
lessons.indicator_en: Gives an accurate message and checks the resident's own next step.

lessons.objective_en: Given a breastfeeding concern, provide approved counseling and identify when qualified help is needed.
lessons.practice_en: Supervised positioning/attachment demonstration with training props, where approved.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses reviewed steps, observes respectfully, and refers when the issue exceeds BHW scope.

lessons.objective_en: Given a child's age and household food options, explain the reviewed age-appropriate feeding approach.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses the approved age guide, checks comprehension, and avoids unverified quantities.

lessons.objective_en: Given a child program card, identify the due service and address a caregiver concern using current local program guidance.
lessons.indicator_en: Explains the action and referral site without independently prescribing supplements or medicine.

lessons.objective_en: Given an age-group meal and oral-care scenario, demonstrate a reviewed education message and service link.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses the correct reviewed visual and demonstrates/observes the key action.
lessons.title_fil: Pinggang Pinoy at kalusugan ng ngipin

lessons.objective_en: Given a fictional BP concern, explain follow-up and refer according to a reviewed protocol.
lessons.practice_en: BP-counseling scenario; measured skill belongs to 3.10.
lessons.indicator_en: Avoids diagnosis from one reading, communicates concern and follow-up.
lessons.title_fil: Payo at referral sa mataas na presyon

lessons.objective_en: Given a fictional diabetes risk or symptom concern, provide a reviewed prevention/referral message.
lessons.practice_en: NCD risk-form interpretation and glucometer demonstration only with approved supervision.
lessons.indicator_en: Identifies the appropriate service and role boundary; does not make an unsupported treatment claim.

lessons.objective_en: Given a resident's question, explain a reviewed risk-reduction or screening route for colon, lung, cervical, breast, or prostate cancer.
lessons.practice_en: Five case cards and referral conversation.
lessons.indicator_en: Selects a relevant reviewed message, avoids unsupported age/interval claims, and links to a provider.

modules.title_en: Priority area 2: Be Clean, Live Sustainably

lessons.objective_en: Given a household scene, identify a water, sanitation, food-safety, or waste concern and an appropriate partner/action.
lessons.practice_en: WASH household walk-through and action map.
lessons.indicator_en: Describes the observed condition, a feasible reviewed action, and who should handle it.

lessons.objective_en: Given a cough and treatment-support case, explain current TB service access and BHW follow-up role.
lessons.practice_en: Referral and treatment-card simulation with fictional data.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses non-stigmatizing language, refers through the verified route, and records only authorized facts.

lessons.objective_en: Given a household risk map and symptom case, choose prevention and escalation actions.
lessons.indicator_en: Identifies breeding-site action and flags concerning illness per reviewed protocol.

lessons.objective_en: Given an animal-bite case, communicate the reviewed first response and urgent referral route.
lessons.indicator_en: Selects the approved pathway and avoids waiting for animal symptoms or improvised treatment.

lessons.objective_en: Given an older-person household case, explain reviewed cough etiquette, prevention, and service options.
lessons.indicator_en: Gives a current message and checks the resident's plan.

lessons.objective_en: Given a misconception, explain a reviewed transmission/prevention distinction without stigma.
lessons.indicator_en: Corrects the misconception and identifies where to confirm testing/vaccination or care.

lessons.objective_en: Given a flood-exposure concern, convey prevention and referral guidance from the current local protocol.
lessons.indicator_en: Distinguishes prevention from clinical prescribing and refers appropriately.

lessons.objective_en: Given a changing local advisory, locate the current official response and communicate a safe household action.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses the latest supplied advisory rather than memorized 2022 isolation or treatment details.

lessons.objective_en: In a locally relevant case, connect WASH prevention with a reviewed referral message.
lessons.indicator_en: Gives a correct prevention action and identifies care for concerning illness.

lessons.objective_en: In an endemic or travel-relevant case, identify a locally verified prevention and referral route.
lessons.indicator_en: States that local relevance must be confirmed and refers a suspected case.
lessons.title_fil: Malaria kung may lokal na panganib

lessons.objective_en: Given a persistent skin-change concern, respond without stigma and direct to assessment.
lessons.indicator_en: Protects privacy and connects the person to the reviewed service.

lessons.objective_en: In locally relevant cases, match each disease to its reviewed exposure-prevention and assessment pathway.
lessons.indicator_en: Keeps the two conditions distinct and checks local program applicability.

lessons.objective_en: Given a fictional child card and the current approved schedule, identify a due/missed visit and counsel the caregiver.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses the current schedule, verifies uncertain entries, and arranges follow-up.

lessons.objective_en: Given an adult concern, identify which current local vaccine program to ask about and where to refer.
lessons.indicator_en: Does not promise eligibility, stock, timing, or price without verification.
lessons.title_fil: Bakuna para sa adulto at nakatatanda

modules.title_fil: Iwasan ang tabako, alak at droga
modules.title_en: Priority area 4: Avoid tobacco, alcohol, and drugs

lessons.objective_en: Given a smoker's concern or community exposure, give a reviewed prevention/cessation message and support route.
lessons.practice_en: Brief conversation and barangay-policy idea card.
lessons.indicator_en: Asks permission, avoids blame, and identifies a realistic next step.

lessons.objective_en: Given a disclosure or family concern, respond without diagnosis or shame and connect to qualified help.
lessons.indicator_en: Maintains privacy, avoids coercive language, and uses a verified route.
lessons.title_fil: Paglapit sa may concern sa droga

lessons.objective_en: Given an alcohol-related concern, identify risk, a safe conversation, and referral boundary.
lessons.indicator_en: Describes observations rather than labels and links to care where needed.
lessons.title_fil: Paglapit sa may concern sa alak

modules.title_en: Priority area 5: Care for Yourself, Care for Others

lessons.objective_en: Given a resident's concern, use supportive language and identify a reviewed self/community support step.
lessons.indicator_en: Listens, checks safety and consent, and avoids diagnosis or dismissive myths.
lessons.title_fil: Pakinggan ang concern sa kalusugan ng isip

lessons.objective_en: Given a fictional urgent or non-urgent mental-health situation, choose the verified referral and handover route.
lessons.indicator_en: Protects privacy, communicates necessary facts, and seeks qualified help when indicated.
lessons.title_fil: Iugnay sa tulong sa mental health

lessons.objective_en: Given a confidential question, provide a respectful, age-appropriate reviewed message and service link.
lessons.indicator_en: Does not block access, shame, or disclose private information.
lessons.title_fil: Usapan sa kabataang may tanong sa SRH

lessons.objective_en: Given a partner scenario, explain consent and a reviewed safer-sex option.
lessons.indicator_en: Centers voluntary decision-making and names a source of further help.
lessons.title_fil: Pahintulot at mas ligtas na pagpili

lessons.objective_en: Given a resident's priorities, describe broad method categories and arrange provider counseling using current materials.
lessons.indicator_en: Explains choice without selecting or prescribing a method for the resident.

lessons.objective_en: Given a pregnancy case, identify a reviewed prenatal service, danger concern, and follow-up route.
lessons.indicator_en: Communicates urgency where indicated and refers through the approved pathway.

lessons.objective_en: Given a labor/newborn case, describe the BHW's support and the qualified birth/newborn-care team pathway.
lessons.indicator_en: Avoids representing unsupervised clinical procedures as BHW tasks.
lessons.title_fil: Suporta sa panganganak at agarang pag-aalaga

lessons.objective_en: Given a postpartum case, identify approved follow-up services and concerning signs.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses reviewed timing and referral rules, confirms local service availability.

lessons.objective_en: Given a newborn concern, reinforce approved essential care and link to assessment when needed.
lessons.indicator_en: Gives a current reviewed message and recognizes a referral trigger.
lessons.title_fil: Payo sa pag-aalaga ng bagong silang

modules.title_en: Priority area 7: Do No Harm, Put Safety First

lessons.objective_en: Given a disclosure or observation, respond privately and connect to the locally verified protection/health pathway.
lessons.indicator_en: Avoids blaming or unsafe disclosure; records only authorized facts and escalates per protocol.

lessons.objective_en: Given an older resident's concern, explain a reviewed safety action and where to verify entitlements.
lessons.indicator_en: Distinguishes confirmed benefits from locally unverified requirements.

lessons.objective_en: Given a seasonal campaign, give an approved prevention and urgent-care message.
lessons.indicator_en: States an actionable prevention step and referral route.

lessons.objective_en: Given a pedestrian/rider risk scene, propose a practical prevention and community-reporting action.
lessons.indicator_en: Identifies the risk, safer behavior, and relevant partner.

lessons.objective_en: Given approved equipment, a fictional client, and a current measurement protocol, take, record, and communicate a BP reading within scope.
lessons.practice_en: Supervised return demonstration with a training partner.
lessons.indicator_en: Completes every critical step on the approved checklist; records actual reading and escalates per current protocol.
lessons.title_fil: Sukatin at iulat ang presyon ng dugo

lessons.objective_en: Given a watch and training partner, measure, record, and report pulse using the approved protocol.
lessons.indicator_en: Finds appropriate site, measures for required interval, records units/time and flags concern.

lessons.objective_en: Given a training partner and thermometer, measure and record both accurately.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses the reviewed method, avoids contaminating equipment, records value/units and escalates concern.

lessons.objective_en: Given age-appropriate tools, perform and document measurement with dignity and assistance where needed.
lessons.indicator_en: Selects correct equipment, positions safely, reads and records units accurately.

lessons.objective_en: Given fictional child measurements and an approved chart, plot correctly and identify whether qualified review is needed.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses correct chart/axis/date and avoids independent diagnosis.

lessons.objective_en: Given approved tape and a training model, measure and record MUAC and identify the reviewed referral action.
lessons.indicator_en: Finds the approved site, avoids tape error, records value and follows current threshold guidance.

lessons.objective_en: Given fictional height/weight/age, calculate or plot using the correct approved tool and state a safe follow-up.
lessons.indicator_en: Selects adult BMI versus child/adolescent chart correctly, shows units and refers for interpretation where required.
lessons.title_fil: BMI at angkop na chart ayon sa edad

modules.title_fil: Profiling ng sambahayan at mga target list

lessons.objective_en: Given synthetic service events, choose ITR, household profile, or target list and identify who maintains it.
lessons.indicator_en: Uses the right record for the purpose and protects identifying data.
lessons.title_fil: Layunin at pag-iingat sa health records

lessons.objective_en: Given a fictional household change, complete and update the locally approved profile.
lessons.indicator_en: Captures required fields, identifies changed information and corrects without inventing data.
lessons.title_fil: Punan at i-update ang household profile

lessons.objective_en: Given fictional profiles, identify eligible entries for WRA and pregnancy/postpartum lists and hand them to the midwife.
lessons.indicator_en: Transfers approved fields accurately, avoids duplicate/missing entries and uses private handover.

lessons.objective_en: Given fictional ages and services, update newborn, infant, child/adolescent and oral-health target lists.
lessons.indicator_en: Classifies age group correctly under current forms and flags due follow-up.
lessons.title_fil: Listahan ng bata at oral health

lessons.objective_en: Given fictional adults, update NCD and older-person lists and identify a reviewed follow-up service.
lessons.indicator_en: Applies approved age grouping and records only authorized information.
lessons.title_fil: Listahan ng adulto at senior citizen

lessons.objective_en: Given a fictional household WASH survey, complete the four-part local sanitation record and hand over a concern.
lessons.indicator_en: Completes water, sanitation, waste and facility fields consistently, then reports the issue.
lessons.title_fil: Tala sa tubig, palikuran at basura

lessons.objective_en: Given several synthetic forms, find missing/contradictory entries, correct from source, and prepare a confidential supervisor handover.
lessons.indicator_en: Finds all critical discrepancies, marks unresolved facts, and follows the approved storage/submission route.
lessons.title_fil: Suriin at ipasa ang mga tala

modules.title_fil: Kagamitan, suplay at talaan ng BHS

lessons.objective_en: Given a local BHS profile, compare actual services with the approved checklist and identify a gap to report.
lessons.indicator_en: Reports a specific gap without promising a service or practicing beyond role.

lessons.objective_en: Given the visually verified source list and local standard, check equipment presence, condition and responsible staff.
lessons.indicator_en: Records item, condition, discrepancy and escalation; distinguishes standard from local stock.

lessons.objective_en: Given a sample room and inventory sheet, reconcile items and document one discrepancy.
lessons.indicator_en: Counts accurately, records date/condition/owner, and follows reconciliation process.

lessons.objective_en: Given a training device and reviewed manufacturer/local protocol, demonstrate cleaning, storage and fault reporting.
lessons.indicator_en: Completes approved care steps safely and does not attempt unauthorized repair.

lessons.objective_en: Given fictional receipts, issues and expiry dates, update a stock card and flag storage/expiry problems.
lessons.indicator_en: Balances counts, applies approved stock rotation, and reports damaged/expired stock.
lessons.title_fil: Stock card at ligtas na suplay ng gamot
